canonical_example.translation: It is better to buy high quality products in the long term.

canonical_example.text: El plazo de entrega de las propuestas concluía ayer.
canonical_example.translation: The deadline for submitting proposals was yesterday.

canonical_example.text: No lo he visto después de tanto plazo fuera.
canonical_example.translation: I haven't seen him after such a long period away.

canonical_example.text: He decidido pagar el coche nuevo a plazos.
canonical_example.translation: I have decided to pay for the new car in installments.
